name: racines
description: Racines — créer, entretenir et récolter son potager, soigner ses plantes et sa basse-cour

scripts.check: rolldown scripts/check-data.ts --platform node --format esm -o .tmp/check.mjs --log-level warn && node .tmp/check.mjs
scripts.smoke: rolldown tests/logic.test.ts --platform node --format esm -o .tmp/logic.mjs --log-level warn && node .tmp/logic.mjs
scripts.build: npm run gen && npm run check && npm run smoke && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.wiki: rolldown scripts/fetch-wiki.ts --platform node --format esm -o .tmp/wiki.mjs --log-level warn && node .tmp/wiki.mjs
scripts.gen: rolldown scripts/gen-guides.ts --platform node --format esm -o .tmp/gen.mjs --log-level warn && node .tmp/gen.mjs
